استرعفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْعَفُوا (istarʕafū) /is.tar.ʕa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
# اُسْتُرْعِفُوا (usturʕifū) /us.tur.ʕi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
# اِسْتَرْعِفُوا (istarʕifū) /is.tar.ʕi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
